scripts.build: npm run build -w @xunjie/contracts && npm run build -w @xunjie/server && npm run build -w @xunjie/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @xunjie/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @xunjie/contracts && npm run test -w @xunjie/contracts && npm run test -w @xunjie/server && npm run test -w @xunjie/web && node scripts/test.mjs tools
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
